articles.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
articles.author: ropbear

zh.thesis: Tailscale定位SQLite 16年WAL重置竞态bug，印证非标准用法是可靠性的真正风险。
points: 6个月19次库损坏，单一writer+手动激进checkpoint触发罕见竞态
SQLite 3.52.0修复后又被撤回，因生成列浮点舍入引起13库误报
tmstmpvfs shim包装VFS层记录WAL，2个月后捕获真实触发证据

en.thesis: Tailscale traced 19 database corruptions to a 16-year-old SQLite WAL-reset race, showing nonstandard use is the real reliability risk.
points: 19 corruptions in six months, triggered by a rare race from single-writer use plus aggressive manual checkpoints
The fix in SQLite 3.52.0 was reverted after generated-column float rounding falsely flagged 13 databases
A tmstmpvfs shim wrapping the VFS layer logged WAL activity and captured real trigger evidence two months later

articles.title: What sort of maths are LLMs good at?
articles.author: ColinWright

zh.thesis: LLM擅长沙取/反例而非洞见式证明，源于其海量知识加快速试错风格而非逻辑优势。
points: OpenAI所解10大难题多为构造反例，如非sofic群与多彩Ramsey超指数下界
Vinogradov三素数定理逻辑同为存在形式却算定理，说明反例界定依赖语境
LLM适合作坊式穷试，人类仍擅概念性与出人意料的证明思路

en.thesis: LLMs excel at extraction and counterexamples rather than insight-driven proofs, thanks to vast knowledge plus fast trial-and-error rather than logical superiority.
points: Most of OpenAI's ten solved problems are constructive counterexamples, like non-sofic groups and super-exponential Ramsey lower bounds
Vinogradov's three-primes theorem is likewise existential in form yet counts as a theorem, showing counterexample status is context-dependent
LLMs suit workshop-style exhaustive trying, while humans still lead on conceptual and surprising proof ideas

articles.title: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
articles.author: apwheele

zh.thesis: 车牌识别历史数据检索应需搜查令，现行保留与审计制度既防不了滥用也限制合法侦查。
points: 新罕布什尔3分钟保留过短，弗吉尼亚21天，多数州约30天
删除数据不防滥用：滥用者周期性搜索并记录，反会损调查与辩护
保留数据而非删除+强制令状+第三方独立审计（州检察长办）为最优解

en.thesis: Searches of historical license-plate-reader data should require a warrant; current retention and audit practices neither stop abuse nor help legitimate investigation.
points: Retention is too short at three minutes in New Hampshire and 21 days in Virginia, with most states at about 30 days
Deleting data does not stop abuse - abusers search periodically and log results, damaging investigations and defense
Keeping data instead of erasing it, plus a warrant mandate and independent third-party audits by the state AG, is the best path

zh.thesis: AI代理应用应拆分为十种架构模式，用不同模型分工而非单一强模型兜底。
points: 链式5步各95%成功率整体仅约77%，误差随步骤累积
frontier模型每token贵5-10倍，transcript重发使单一大模型更贵
先全用最强model验证功能，再有evals后逐岗降级换便宜模型

en.thesis: AI agent apps should split into ten architectural patterns and divide work across different models rather than lean on one strong model.
points: A five-step chain at 95% per step lands at only ~77% overall, with error accumulating per step
Frontier models cost 5-10x more per token, and transcript resending makes a single big model pricier
Validate features with the strongest model first, then downgrade per role to cheaper models once evals exist

articles.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering
articles.author: florianherrengt

zh.thesis: AI让实现变廉价，削弱工程文化项目加速崩坏，两极化薪资挤压平庸工程师。
points: 平庸者一天可产过去一年代码量，PR可超24506行难以审查
回滚坏决定极难：数据库加表10分钟，迁移修复需数周且五倍新PR涌入
可雇佣线=当前最强模型能力，好工程因AI增速更稀缺，差工程更难被雇

en.thesis: AI makes implementation cheap, eroding engineering culture and accelerating project decay while compressing salaries at both ends.
points: A middling engineer can now produce a year's worth of code in a day, with PRs exceeding 24,506 lines that are hard to review
Rolling back bad decisions is brutal: adding a DB column takes 10 minutes, but fixing the migration takes weeks and draws five times more new PRs
The hireable line now tracks the strongest model's ability - good engineering becomes rarer with AI, while poor engineering gets harder to employ

articles.title: Google's AI found a Chrome bug hiding for 13 years, and it's only getting faster
articles.author: Rich Edmonds

zh.thesis: Google用专业AI智能体重写漏洞管理全流程，两周修复量超过去23个里程碑总和。
points: Chrome 149/150共修复1072个安全漏洞，AI补丁量超以往23个里程碑之和
DeepMind与Project Zero工具每日扫描，5月单月拦住20+漏洞进入生产
推动两周一发布加动态热修补，缩短公开源码与补丁部署的patch gap

en.thesis: Google's specialist AI agents rebooted its entire vulnerability-management pipeline, fixing more in two weeks than across all prior milestones.
points: Chrome 149/150 fixed 1,072 security bugs, with AI-authored patches exceeding the total from all 23 earlier milestones
DeepMind and Project Zero tools scan daily, blocking 20+ vulnerabilities from reaching production in May alone
A shift to biweekly releases plus dynamic hot-patching narrows the gap between public source and shipped patches

articles.title: Most people pay $20 for Claude Code, but OpenCode Go is $10 and I can barely spend a dollar of it
articles.author: Adam Conway

zh.thesis: OpenCode Go月费10美元，DeepSeek V4 Flash近乎免费，使Claude Code定价显得昂贵。
points: V4 Flash全日44次分析含大context仅耗3美分，SWE-bench 79%追平Sonnet 4.6
Kimi K3为2.8T参最大开源模型，被白宫指控蒸馏Fable但研究员质疑可行性
K3限110请求/5小时，V4 Flash可到63300次，适合80/20混合路由

en.thesis: OpenCode Go at $10 a month plus near-free DeepSeek V4 Flash makes Claude Code's $20 look expensive.
points: A full day of 44 analysis runs with large context cost only 3 cents on V4 Flash, which ties Sonnet 4.6 at 79% on SWE-bench
Kimi K3 is the largest open-source model at 2.8T parameters; the White House claims it distilled Fable, though researchers question feasibility
K3 is capped at 110 requests per 5 hours while V4 Flash reaches 63,300, suiting an 80/20 mixed routing

zh.thesis: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B开源模型发布，2.4T参数激活95B，首次开源Qwen-Max级能力。
points: 总参2.4T、激活95B，MoE含512专家选10个路由+1共享
原生262K上下文，可扩展至101万tokens
SWE-bench Pro 67.7、DeepSWE 56.6，落后Claude Opus 4.8约12分

en.thesis: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is an open-source model bringing Qwen-Max-class capability to the public with 2.4T parameters.
points: 2.4T total parameters with 95B active via a MoE of 512 experts routing 10, plus one shared expert
Native 262K context, expandable to 1.01M tokens
SWE-bench Pro 67.7 and DeepSWE 56.6, roughly 12 points behind Claude Opus 4.8

articles.title: 5 Rules for a Second Brain You’ll Actually Use
articles.author: JA Westenberg

zh.thesis: 第二大脑应人工摄入、围绕问题组织、容异见并定期删除，而非自动囤积。
points: 自动化摄取一月即产出难处理的噪音，须判断后才保存
按主题归档是无效分类，改用问题或限时项目做tag更促思考
每周至少删1/5，审查必须以产出物收尾否则无意义

en.thesis: A second brain should be fed manually, organized around problems, tolerate dissent, and get pruned regularly - not auto-hoarded.
points: Automated ingestion produces unmanageable noise within a month; you must judge before saving
Archiving by topic is ineffective; using problem or time-boxed project tags better drives thinking
Delete at least 1/5 weekly, and any review must end in an output or it is pointless

articles.title: I can't believe how good this AI coding model is, and it isn't from OpenAI or Anthropic
articles.author: Parth Shah

zh.thesis: 作者推荐Grok 4.5在Cursor中的token效率，声称构建整站仅耗约40k tokens。
points: 整站前端仅耗约40k tokens，小改动不重读无关文件
作者仍会在复杂任务切回Fable 5与Claude Code
属于主观体验测评，未见可复现基准数据

en.thesis: The author recommends Grok 4.5 in Cursor for token efficiency, claiming an entire site build consumed only about 40k tokens.
points: A full front-end site used only ~40k tokens, and small edits did not re-read unrelated files
The author still switches back to Fable 5 and Claude Code for complex tasks
This is subjective hands-on evaluation with no reproducible benchmark data
